description: This file contains the implementation of recap-related functionalities in the Mattermost server, including creating, retrieving, updating, regenerating, deleting recaps, and processing channels for recaps with post summarization.

classes.name: App
classes.description: Main application struct providing recap management functionalities.

methods.name: CreateRecap
methods.description: Creates a new recap record and background job for specified channels.

methods.name: GetRecap
methods.description: Retrieves a recap by its ID, including associated channels.

methods.name: GetRecapsForUser
methods.description: Retrieves all recaps for a specific user with pagination.

methods.name: MarkRecapAsRead
methods.description: Marks a recap as read and updates its timestamp.

methods.name: RegenerateRecap
methods.description: Resets an existing recap, deletes old channels, and creates a new background job.

methods.name: ProcessRecapChannel
methods.description: Processes a single channel for recap: fetches posts, summarizes, and saves recap channel record.

methods.name: fetchPostsForRecap
methods.description: Fetches recent posts after last viewed timestamp, enriches with user info, limited by count.

methods.name: extractPostIDs
methods.description: Extracts post IDs from a list of post objects.
